name: C++ I — Fundamentals & Pointers
description: Master C++ syntax, memory addresses, pointers, references, functions, arrays, and build a Library Management System.
whatYouLearn: Master C++ primitive types, control flow, and I/O streams
Understand memory addresses and pointer arithmetic
Pass arguments by reference via pointers
Build a Library Management System Capstone
